claims.hypothesis: Can a rotating disk plus radial motion model explain the inner CO(2-1) kinematics?
claims.experiment: 3DBarolo tilted-ring fit with local and azim normalisations
claims.result: Models reproduce velocity field and most of the structure; not regions F and H or the dispersion map
claims.finding: Overall structure is rotation plus inflow, with non-axisymmetric exceptions

evidence.quote: we cannot consider our best-fit model as fully explanatory of the gas kinematic in NGC 5135, but only an approximation

claims.hypothesis: What is the origin of the two-velocity region F?
claims.experiment: Examine channel maps, spectra, PV minor axis
claims.result: Empty cavity bounded by +/-70 km/s blobs

evidence.quote: resembles an expanding super-bubble

claims.hypothesis: Does the nuclear mm flux match torus-only SED expectations?
claims.experiment: Compare B6 and B9 flux of region A with SED decomposition
claims.result: Flux exceeds torus-only expectation by about two orders of magnitude
claims.finding: Upper limit to torus; possible contamination from SF or colder dust

evidence.quote: largely exceed the SED decomposition expectations for torus only (by about two orders of magnitude)

why_this_data.value: Archival ALMA B6 and B9 data available for this Seyfert galaxy

evidence.quote: For one of these Seyfert galaxies, NGC 5135, ALMA data were available in the archive in two bands

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: SNR and AGN outflow origins for region F were discarded

evidence.quote: Hence the SNR origin hypothesis is likely to be discarded for no clear evidence of the presence of the remnant.

limitations_admitted.value: B9 maximum recoverable scale is small, so fluxes between bands are not comparable

evidence.quote: any direct comparison between the fluxes measured in the two bands will not be possible

limitations_admitted.value: Bar-induced non-circular motions are not fully reconstructed

evidence.quote: the presence of the nuclear bar at the centre of NGC 5135 introduces motions in the innermost gas that the $^{3D}$`BAROLO` software is unable to reconstruct perfectly

referee_caveats_inferred: Inclination from a DSS outer-disc ellipse may not apply to the inner gas disk
Thin-disk, axisymmetric assumption in a barred region
Super-bubble interpretation is qualitative, with no quantitative energetics
